Subject: Post-call recap + proposal for dedicated sizing call

Hi Jane / Sam —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary use case: document ingestion + semantic search for clinical notes.
- Expected peak concurrent requests: ~120 sessions/min; average prompt length ~450 tokens; tail latency target <500ms p95.
- Sensitive data flows through a private VPC; customer requires KMS integration and audit logs.

For the next step I recommend a 45–60 minute dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) so our infra team can validate throughput assumptions and recommend a Dedicated pool configuration and autoscaling policy. To keep this tight, please come ready with your recent 24–72h load profile (sample traffic) and any retention/KV-cache expectations.

Proposed slots (ET):
- Tue Jun 1 — 11:00–12:00 ET
- Wed Jun 2 — 10:00–11:00 ET
- Wed Jun 2 — 15:00–16:00 ET

If none of those work, share a couple of alternatives and we can lock the best option. I attached a short post-call notes PDF and our sizing worksheet (load-profile.xlsx) to help collect the data ahead of the call.

Next steps if we lock a slot:
1) Ben or Irene will join for a short intake to confirm metrics we need.
2) Customer sends sample traffic (CSV) and any latency SLO constraints.
3) We provide a preliminary Dedicated capacity recommendation within 48h after the call.

Attachments: post-call-notes.pdf, load-profile.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
